add_product_to_catalog: add a new product to the shopping catalog by name and get its product ID
add_item_to_product: add an item variant with price and options to an existing product in the catalog
add_to_cart: add an available item to the shopping cart with a specified quantity
checkout_with_discount: checkout the cart and create an order with an optional discount code applied
cancel_order: cancel an order that is in processed or shipped status
